shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && git ls-files | head -30

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch RadioButton; grep -n -i "theme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch RadioButton 2>&1 | head -60; rg -n -C3 "useTheme|setTheme|ThemeProvider|systemTheme|Provider" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>&1 | head -120; ls build/esm/components/RadioButton build/esm/components/Switch | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts theme/useThemeType.d.ts theme/index.d.ts theme/useSystemTheme.d.ts; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; ls | grep -i -E "radio|segmented"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/tsconfig.json
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short
